name: Ammonites The
overview: The Ammonites, descendants of Lot and neighbors to Israel, are depicted in Scripture as idolatrous and hostile toward God's people. Judges 10 reveals that Israel's repeated sin and abandonment of the LORD led to their oppression by the Ammonites, who vexed and fought against Israel and Judah for eighteen years. Despite Israel's distress, their repentance and return to the LORD brought His mercy, highlighting the consequences of forsaking God and the hope found in His deliverance.
